name: plan-tracker
description: Multi-phase project plans in docs/plans/ or a folder you name, one phase per session. Skills write a plan, run a phase, put its open questions to you, hand off and clean up; a pane shows the plans, names sessions after their plan and phase, starts the next phase in a cleared context (a button, or /next-phase), and reminds Claude to update a plan when it finishes a phase

plansDir.title: Plans folder
plansDir.description: Where plans are kept in a workspace that does not say (see /plans-dir). A relative path, such as docs/plans, is looked for in the session's folder and each folder above it. An absolute path, or one that starts with ~, is one folder for every project.
